title: The Nihilist Reading Of Anne Rice #Shorts
description:
Meaning is not found in Anne Rice — it is manufactured for it. Anne Rice (born Howard Allen Frances O'Brien; October 4, 1941 – December 11, 2021) was an American author of Gothic fiction, erotic literature, and Bible fiction. She later adapted the first volume in the series into a commercially successful film, Interview with the Vampire (1994).

Evolution does not optimize for happiness — Anne Rice shows exactly where that breaks. After moving to Rancho Mirage, California in 2006, Rice wrote a second volume Christ the Lord: The Road to Cana, published in March 2008, and was working on a third Christ the Lord: Kingdom of Heaven in November 2008. She also wrote the first two books in her Songs of the Seraphim series, Angel Time and Of Love and Evil, and her memoir Called Out of Darkness: A Spiritual Confession.
